name: Global MP3 Player
description: Replaces level music with your own MP3 and adds beat-reactive visual effects.

enable-replacement.name: Enable Music Replacement
enable-replacement.description: Master switch for replacing game music with your custom track.

music-path.name: Path to MP3 file
music-path.description: Select the MP3 file you want to play instead of level music.

replace-menu-music.name: Replace Menu Music
replace-menu-music.description: Also replaces the main menu music.

screen-pulse.name: Screen Pulse
screen-pulse.description: Flashes the screen with an additive overlay on strong beats.

random-color-pulse.name: BG Color Change (Beat)
random-color-pulse.description: Changes the ACTUAL level background color to a random vivid color on each beat.

side-waves.name: Side Waves
side-waves.description: Adds reactive wave bars on both sides of the screen.

screen-shake.name: Screen Shake
screen-shake.description: Shakes the screen on strong beats for extra immersion.

beat-sensitivity.name: Beat Sensitivity
beat-sensitivity.description: How sensitive the beat detector is. Higher = more frequent beats.

player-pulse.name: Player Pulse
player-pulse.description: Scales and flashes the player icon on beats.

beat-particles.name: Beat Particles
beat-particles.description: Emits particle explosions on strong beats.

chromatic-glitch.name: Chromatic Glitch
chromatic-glitch.description: Adds RGB split glitch effect on beats.

show-mini-player.name: Show Mini-Player
show-mini-player.description: Shows track name and progress bar in game.
